name: Queen
notes: Notched as a juvenile by Ivo Perch when he lifted her out of the lower sluice. She knows mill-gate grease and a two-note whistle. She is an animal, not a magistrate.

name: Bramble
notes: Cal Voss's dog. Recognizes a stance at the rail. Dies in the oath year no matter what Ellis does.

name: the March cow
notes: Henry March's cow that walks to the old grease-salt at the abandoned gate site. Not a symbol on purpose.

name: Invoice
notes: Cora Belden's mare. Promised to a 4-H girl and also listed against a feed bill.
